standard-dialogue-before-tower-of-life.player: You seem to like playing with danger, there.

standard-dialogue-before-tower-of-life.npc: They don't call me 'No-fingers' for nothing!

standard-dialogue-before-tower-of-life.player: Well, correct me if I'm wrong, but you seem to have all your fingers.

standard-dialogue-before-tower-of-life.npc: It may seem that way mate, but I think you'll find I don't have any.
These not be fingers. These 'ere be wooden fingers.

standard-dialogue-before-tower-of-life.player: That's not possible, how could you move them?
Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.

standard-dialogue-after-tower-of-life.npc: Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...

standard-dialogue-after-tower-of-life.player: Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!
